description: Telemetry readings from one Environment Agency monitoring station — water level in metres, river flow in m3/s, or rainfall in mm, typically every 15 minutes. AUTHORITATIVE for "how high is the <English river> at <place> right now". Pass a station reference from ukflood_stations_near, e.g. "5380TH" (Walthamstow, Low Hall, River Lee). Defaults to the latest reading for every measure at the station; pass since to get a time series.

limit.description: Max readings to return (default 50, max 500). Only applies with since.

since.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp, e.g. "2026-09-16T00:00:00Z". When given, returns every reading since then instead of only the latest.

station_id.description: EA station reference, e.g. "5380TH". Get one from ukflood_stations_near.

name: ukflood_station_readings
